rv.q: KILLING MUSICALS looks to blend pathos, satire and female empowerment not always particularly smoothly.
If the title alone of 'Millennials are Killing Musicals' intrigues you, know that the show fully delivers on its suggestion of theatrical fun.
On the other hand, the book aches for a more experienced writer or dramaturg to streamline the muddled and somewhat nonsensical storyline.
Seriously lacking in cohesion and devoid of an emotional core, Juber's show too often descends into silliness.
What I ended up getting was a hodgepodge of a musical that's not without its plusses but is nothing at all like what its title would suggest or anything close to the caliber show I was hoping to see.
